PROGRAM 1 :


package selenium;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;

public class program1 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		WebDriver driver = new ChromeDriver();



        // Open google.com

        driver.get("https://www.google.com");



        // Verify Title

        String Title = driver.getTitle();

        if (Title.contains("google")) {

            System.out.println("Title Verification Passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Title Verification Failed");
        }
        // Verify URL Redirection
        String currentUrl = driver.getCurrentUrl();
        if (currentUrl.contains("google.com")) {
            System.out.println("Redirected to google.com - Passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Redirected URL: " + currentUrl);
            System.out.println("Redirection Verification Failed");
        }

        // Close Browser

        driver.quit();

	}

}

package selenium;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.edge.EdgeDriver;
public class program3 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		// Create Edge browser instance
        WebDriver driver = new EdgeDriver();

        // Open Google
        driver.get("https://www.gmail.com");

        // Maximize window
        driver.manage().window().maximize();

        // Print page title
        System.out.println("Title: " + driver.getTitle());

        // Close browser
        // driver.quit();et("https://www.google.com");

        System.out.println("Title: " + driver.getTitle());

        driver.quit();

	}

}

PROGRAM 4 :


package selenium;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.edge.EdgeDriver;

public class program4 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		

		WebDriver driver = new ChromeDriver();   
         driver = new ChromeDriver();   
        // Open website
        driver.get("https://www.google.com");
        // Print title
        System.out.println("Page Title: " + driver.getTitle());
        System.out.println("Chrome Opened Successfully");
     // Close browser
        driver.quit();
        
        
        WebDriver driver1 = new EdgeDriver();
        driver1.get("https://www.google.com");

        // Maximize window
        driver1.manage().window().maximize();

        // Print page title
        System.out.println("Title: " + driver1.getTitle());
        System.out.println("Edge Opened Successfully");
        driver1.quit();

	}

}

PROGRAM 5 :


package selenium;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

import org.openqa.selenium.By;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebElement;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.Select;
public class program5 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// Get input from user
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.print("Enter the option to search: ");
        String searchItem = sc.nextLine();

        // Launch Chrome
        WebDriver driver = new ChromeDriver();

        // Open DemoQA webpage
        driver.get("https://demoqa.com/select-menu");
        driver.manage().window().maximize();

        // Locate the Old Style Select Menu
        WebElement dropdown = driver.findElement(By.id("oldSelectMenu"));

        // Create Select object
        Select select = new Select(dropdown);

        // Get all options
        List<WebElement> options = select.getOptions();

        boolean found = false;

        // Search the option
        for (int i = 0; i < options.size(); i++) {

            String text = options.get(i).getText();

            if (text.equalsIgnoreCase(searchItem)) {

                System.out.println(searchItem + " is present in the list box.");
                System.out.println("Position of the element: " + (i + 1));

                // Select the option
                select.selectByVisibleText(text);

                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!found) {
            System.out.println(searchItem + " is NOT present in the list box.");
        }

        sc.close();
        driver.quit();
	}

}

PROGRAM 6 :


package selenium;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

import org.openqa.selenium.By;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebElement;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.Select;

public class program6 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		 // Launch Chrome
        WebDriver driver = new ChromeDriver();

        // Open DemoQA Select Menu page
        driver.get("https://demoqa.com/select-menu");
        driver.manage().window().maximize();

        // Locate the Old Style Select Menu
        WebElement dropdown = driver.findElement(By.id("oldSelectMenu"));

        // Create Select object
        Select select = new Select(dropdown);

        // Get all options
        List<WebElement> options = select.getOptions();

        // Store option text in ArrayList
        ArrayList<String> colors = new ArrayList<>();

        for (WebElement option : options) {
            colors.add(option.getText());
        }

        // Sort the list
        Collections.sort(colors);

        // Print sorted options
        System.out.println("Contents of the list in sorted order:");

        for (String color : colors) {
            System.out.println(color);
        }

        // Close browser
        driver.quit();

	}

}

PROGRAM 7 :


package selenium;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;

import org.openqa.selenium.By;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebElement;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.Select;

public class program7 {

    public static void main(String[] args) throws InterruptedException {
    	
    	// Launch Chrome Browser
        WebDriver driver = new ChromeDriver();

        // Open the webpage
        driver.get("https://manojkumar3549g.github.io/duplicate-dropdown/");
        driver.manage().window().maximize();

        // Locate the dropdown
        WebElement dropdown = driver.findElement(By.id("country"));

        // Create Select object
        Select select = new Select(dropdown);

        // Get all options
        List<WebElement> options = select.getOptions();

        // Create HashSet to store unique options
        HashSet<String> uniqueOptions = new HashSet<>();

        // Add options to HashSet
        for (WebElement option : options) {
            uniqueOptions.add(option.getText());
        }

        // Print unique options
        System.out.println("Unique Options in the List Box:");

        for (String option : uniqueOptions) {
            System.out.println(option);
        }

        // Close browser
        driver.quit();

        
    }
}


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PROGRAM 8 :


package selenium;

import java.util.Set;

import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;
public class program8 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		
		// Launch browser
        WebDriver driver = new ChromeDriver();

        // Open first website
        driver.get("https://www.google.com");

        // Open second window
        driver.switchTo().newWindow(org.openqa.selenium.WindowType.WINDOW);
        driver.get("https://www.amazon.in");

        // Open third window
        driver.switchTo().newWindow(org.openqa.selenium.WindowType.WINDOW);
        driver.get("https://www.flipkart.com");

        // Get all window handles
        Set<String> windows = driver.getWindowHandles();

        // Close each browser window
        for (String window : windows) {
            driver.switchTo().window(window);
            driver.close();
        }

	}

}
